newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz-bank merger to take up 9 pct of capital.
newsitem.headline: Allianz-bank merger to take up 9 pct of capital.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG said on Monday that a share offer made as part of a bank merger would take up nine percent of its capital and said the merger would place up to nine billion marks of its shares.

In a compulsory statement, Allianz said it holds 22.1 percent of Hypo-Bank and four percent of Vereinsbank, which earlier said the two banks would merge from October this year. It will hold 15 percent of the merged bank.
In the statement, the Allianz board said it could not rule out that the merger and the share exchange would have an effect on the Allianz share price.
Allianz said that it will hold 15 percent of the new merged bank, making it the biggest shareholder.
Allianz said that the merger will increase the value of Allianz's stakes in Bavarian banks. It would also increase its shareholder numbers and thereby its liquidity, the insurer said.
Allianz said the bank merger was optimal for the sale of insurance and asset plans. The share exchange would increase its holdings among small shareholders by between 20 percent and 25 percent.
Vereinsbank said that the Allianz shares for the exchange would come from its holdings.
